goal: Ensure subtree updates can be backported directly to release branches without redundant re-review
Help maintainers preserve identical merge commit hashes across branches
agreement: Strong support for enforcing subtree backporting practices to save review effort (ryanofsky)
Verified by testing that the check properly flags errors and allows bypasses (BrandonOdiwuor)
Early concern about rare merge adjustments was settled with an opt-out flag (maflcko)

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because it improves internal repository hygiene rather than test coverage for node features
Saves backporting and review effort for maintainers across release branches
A modest workflow enhancement that is deferrable without blocking development
